title: Open web steel joists.
officialText:
Open web steel joists that are hoisted singly shall be transferred from their place of
storage directly to their permanent location and safely secured. No load shall be placed on open web steel joists until they
are permanently fastened in place or otherwise secured in accordance with methods approved by the registered design
professional of record.
